settings.title: FAQs
settings.text: Shipping, sizing, drops and returns — the questions we get asked most.

settings.question: Where do you ship?
settings.answer: We ship globally. UK & International shipping is available on all orders.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: UK: 2–5 working days | International: 5–10 working days. Please allow 24–48 hours for dispatch.

settings.question: Are drops limited?
settings.answer: Yes. We operate on a limited-drop model to maintain exclusivity. Once it's gone, it's gone.

settings.question: How do the items fit?
settings.answer: Our sizing is generally true to size with a relaxed, streetwear fit. For the shorts and hoodies, we recommend sticking to your usual size for a comfortable fit, or sizing up if you prefer an oversized look.

settings.question: Can I wash the printed items?
settings.answer: Yes, but handle with care. We recommend washing inside out on a cold cycle and air drying. Do not iron directly over the print or logos to preserve the quality.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order is dispatched, you will receive an email with a tracking number. You can use this link to monitor your package's journey to your doorstep.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), as well as PayPal and Apple Pay.

settings.question: Can I change my order after placing it?
settings.answer: We process orders quickly to get them to you fast. If you need to make a change, please email us immediately. If the order has already been dispatched, we cannot make changes.
